build_template_pair_feat: build template pair features from batched atom positions including distogram and rigid body vectors
build_template_angle_feat: build template angle features by concatenating one-hot aatype with torsion angles and masks
build_extra_msa_feat: build extra MSA feature tensor by concatenating one-hot MSA with deletion values
pseudo_beta_fn: compute pseudo beta coordinates from atom positions using CA for glycine and CB for other residues
frames_and_literature_positions_to_atom1: compute atom14 positions from rigid frames and literature atom positions
